notes: Engine text is English. Map codes, statuses, actions and the `translate` warnings; show anything else verbatim (never drop it).
`text` uses %1$s… for runtime values (Android format syntax, %% is a literal percent); `pattern` is anchored, one group per placeholder, in order.
When several patterns match one text, use the entry with the longest `text` (e.g. "Input %1$s sighash" before "Input %1$s").
hits = occurrences in the golden-vector reviews (core/jsengine/src/androidTest/assets/pubsigner/vectors.json); sites = source locations.

warnings: the 25 translated ones first (translate: true, a frozen curated list in a fixed order), then the others by rank (rank = corpus frequency rank). ownbitAlias: an untranslated engine warning Ownbit shows with its own string of the same meaning (PublicProtocol.warn.<id>).

warnings.text: %1$s more order-specific warning%2$s not listed here. Review every order in the signed values.
warnings.pattern: ^([\s\S]+?) more order-specific warning([\s\S]+?) not listed here\. Review every order in the signed values\.$

warnings.text: A collection offer must have exactly one amount; this order cannot be filled.
warnings.pattern: ^A collection offer must have exactly one amount; this order cannot be filled\.$

warnings.text: A royalty/transfer rule set will be evaluated on-chain and cannot be checked offline.
warnings.pattern: ^A royalty/transfer rule set will be evaluated on-chain and cannot be checked offline\.$

warnings.text: Available staked resources, pending unfreezes and delegation state cannot be verified offline.
warnings.pattern: ^Available staked resources, pending unfreezes and delegation state cannot be verified offline\.$

warnings.text: Closing this token account sends all of its remaining SOL to the specified recipient. For a wrapped SOL account this is the entire wrapped balance, not just rent.
warnings.pattern: ^Closing this token account sends all of its remaining SOL to the specified recipient\. For a wrapped SOL account this is the entire wrapped balance, not just rent\.$

warnings.text: Collection plugins (permanent transfer delegate, royalties, freeze) are evaluated on-chain and cannot be checked offline.
warnings.pattern: ^Collection plugins \(permanent transfer delegate, royalties, freeze\) are evaluated on-chain and cannot be checked offline\.$

warnings.text: Core plugins (royalties, freeze, permanent transfer delegate, oracle) can block or alter this transfer and cannot be checked offline.
warnings.pattern: ^Core plugins \(royalties, freeze, permanent transfer delegate, oracle\) can block or alter this transfer and cannot be checked offline\.$

warnings.text: Decimals are not included in this instruction, so the amount is shown in raw units. Without the edition account this may be a fungible token rather than an NFT.
warnings.pattern: ^Decimals are not included in this instruction, so the amount is shown in raw units\. Without the edition account this may be a fungible token rather than an NFT\.$

warnings.text: If the Merkle proof is stale the transaction fails; it cannot affect any asset other than the asset ID shown.
warnings.pattern: ^If the Merkle proof is stale the transaction fails; it cannot affect any asset other than the asset ID shown\.$

warnings.text: If this is an ERC-721 contract, this clears the approval for token %1$s. Many ERC-20 implementations reject a zero spender.
warnings.pattern: ^If this is an ERC-721 contract, this clears the approval for token ([\s\S]+?)\. Many ERC-20 implementations reject a zero spender\.$

warnings.text: Item%1$s %2$s %3$s quantity 0.
LooksRare rejects bids in native ETH, so this bid cannot be filled.
warnings.pattern: ^LooksRare rejects bids in native ETH, so this bid cannot be filled\.$

warnings.text: Mint is not included in this unchecked instruction. Token-account addresses cannot establish asset identity or decimals offline.
warnings.pattern: ^Mint is not included in this unchecked instruction\. Token-account addresses cannot establish asset identity or decimals offline\.$

warnings.text: MultiSend target code and the current Safe policy are unverified offline.
warnings.pattern: ^MultiSend target code and the current Safe policy are unverified offline\.$

warnings.text: NFT name, image and collection are not in the transaction and cannot be verified offline. Compare the asset ID with an independent source.
warnings.pattern: ^NFT name, image and collection are not in the transaction and cannot be verified offline\. Compare the asset ID with an independent source\.$

warnings.text: NFT name, image and collection are not in the transaction and cannot be verified offline. Compare the mint address with an independent source.
warnings.pattern: ^NFT name, image and collection are not in the transaction and cannot be verified offline\. Compare the mint address with an independent source\.$

warnings.text: Neither the leaf owner nor the leaf delegate signs this transaction, so the transfer will fail on-chain.
warnings.pattern: ^Neither the leaf owner nor the leaf delegate signs this transaction, so the transfer will fail on-chain\.$

warnings.text: New permission members shown here are the replacement configuration, not evidence of current signing authority.
warnings.pattern: ^New permission members shown here are the replacement configuration, not evidence of current signing authority\.$

warnings.text: No verifying contract is bound by the signed domain.
warnings.pattern: ^No verifying contract is bound by the signed domain\.$

warnings.text: Non-standard strategy %1$s; its additionalParameters are not decoded.
warnings.pattern: ^Non-standard strategy ([\s\S]+?); its additionalParameters are not decoded\.$

warnings.text: Safe owners and threshold are not independently verified offline.
warnings.pattern: ^Safe owners and threshold are not independently verified offline\.$

warnings.text: Stake authorities, lockups, balances and validator status cannot be verified offline.
warnings.pattern: ^Stake authorities, lockups, balances and validator status cannot be verified offline\.$

warnings.text: The NFT’s name, image and collection are committed only as hashes and cannot be displayed offline. Compare the asset ID with an independent source.
warnings.pattern: ^The NFT’s name, image and collection are committed only as hashes and cannot be displayed offline\. Compare the asset ID with an independent source\.$

warnings.text: The asset’s current owner is not included in the transaction. The signing authority must be the owner or an approved transfer delegate; if this is not your NFT, you are acting as a delegate.
warnings.pattern: ^The asset’s current owner is not included in the transaction\. The signing authority must be the owner or an approved transfer delegate; if this is not your NFT, you are acting as a delegate\.$

warnings.text: The item IDs and amounts do not match, so this order cannot be filled as shown.
warnings.pattern: ^The item IDs and amounts do not match, so this order cannot be filled as shown\.$

warnings.text: The leaf owner%1$s does not sign this transaction, so it will fail on-chain.
warnings.pattern: ^The leaf owner([\s\S]+?) does not sign this transaction, so it will fail on-chain\.$

warnings.text: The order end time is not after its start time, so it cannot be filled.
warnings.pattern: ^The order end time is not after its start time, so it cannot be filled\.$

warnings.text: The quantity is 0, so this transfer moves nothing.
warnings.pattern: ^The quantity is 0, so this transfer moves nothing\.$

warnings.text: The recipient wallet is not included in this transaction, only its token account. Make sure the destination token account belongs to the intended recipient.
warnings.pattern: ^The recipient wallet is not included in this transaction, only its token account\. Make sure the destination token account belongs to the intended recipient\.$

warnings.text: The request included %1$s field(s) that are not part of the signed data. They were ignored and are not shown as signed values.
warnings.pattern: ^The request included ([\s\S]+?) field\(s\) that are not part of the signed data\. They were ignored and are not shown as signed values\.$

warnings.text: The transfer authority does not sign this transaction, so the transfer will fail on-chain.
warnings.pattern: ^The transfer authority does not sign this transaction, so the transfer will fail on-chain\.$

warnings.text: This batch contains no items.
warnings.pattern: ^This batch contains no items\.$

warnings.text: This call also sends %1$s TRX to the contract.
warnings.pattern: ^This call also sends ([\s\S]+?) TRX to the contract\.$

warnings.text: This call also sends %1$s to the contract.
warnings.pattern: ^This call also sends ([\s\S]+?) to the contract\.$

warnings.text: This is a custom permit schema. Its complete signed fields are shown, but application-specific behavior is not fully decoded.
warnings.pattern: ^This is a custom permit schema\. Its complete signed fields are shown, but application-specific behavior is not fully decoded\.$

warnings.text: This listing sells %1$s NFT items together in one order.
warnings.pattern: ^This listing sells ([\s\S]+?) NFT items together in one order\.$

warnings.text: This listing sells %1$s NFT items%2$s together in one order.
warnings.pattern: ^This listing sells ([\s\S]+?) NFT items([\s\S]+?) together in one order\.$

warnings.text: This looks like an NFT (1 unit, 0 decimals), but 0-decimal fungible tokens match the same pattern. NFT name, image, collection and verified status are not in the transaction and cannot be checked offline. Compare the mint address with an independent source.

warnings.text: This order stays valid for more than a year (until %1$s).
warnings.pattern: ^This order stays valid for more than a year \(until ([\s\S]+?)\)\.$

warnings.text: This restricted order is validated by zone %1$s, whose rules are not decoded.
warnings.pattern: ^This restricted order is validated by zone ([\s\S]+?), whose rules are not decoded\.$

warnings.text: Token %1$s appears %2$s times in this batch; its total quantity is %3$s.
warnings.pattern: ^Token ([\s\S]+?) appears ([\s\S]+?) times in this batch; its total quantity is ([\s\S]+?)\.$

warnings.text: Token delegation authorizes another address to spend these assets.
warnings.pattern: ^Token delegation authorizes another address to spend these assets\.$

warnings.text: Token-account owners, mint metadata and decimals are not independently fetched or verified offline.
warnings.pattern: ^Token-account owners, mint metadata and decimals are not independently fetched or verified offline\.$

warnings.text: You receive only %1$s for the items you give. Check that this very low price is intended.
warnings.pattern: ^You receive only ([\s\S]+?) for the items you give\. Check that this very low price is intended\.$
